notes.title: Necrophobia 1.2
notes.content:
[h1]NECROPHOBIA 1.2[/h1][p][/p][h3]Rhythm game fix!:[/h3][list][*][p]Notes within the rhythm games no longer desync from music! Additionally, a "hit" and/or "miss" indicator has been added for extra clarity.[/p][/*][*][p]Both rhythm games now accept "X" as well as "Z" as inputs (clearing up the issue of the second game and the wonky double tap notes).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Remastered tracks!:[/h3][p]Songs that have been remastered:[/p][list][*][p]I trust you.[/p][/*][*][p]It won't last forever![/p][/*][*][p]Sanctuary. (Asylum pt.2)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]ONE typographical error!:[/h3][p]You heard me right- JUST one. Ironically, the error was spelling "stupid" as "supid". (Guess who's route this was in? Hint: He no longer gets holiday bonuses)[/p][p][/p][p]That's all for now, folks! I hope these changes are to all of your likings.
Until we meet again~[/p]

tags.bug: Notes within the rhythm games no longer desync from music! Additionally, a "hit" and/or "miss" indicator has been added for extra clarity.
Both rhythm games now accept "X" as well as "Z" as inputs (clearing up the issue of the second game and the wonky double tap notes).
ONE typographical error!: You heard me right- JUST one. Ironically, the error was spelling "stupid" as "supid". (Guess who's route this was in? Hint: He no longer gets holiday bonuses)

notes.title: Necrophobia MacOS
notes.content:
[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
The problem regarding the "missing executable" popup when attempting to open the game on Mac has now been resolved, and the game opens as it should.

That's all for now-
Until we meet again~

notes.title: Necrophobia OST Update
notes.content:
[b]Remastered Songs:[/b]

[list]
[*] Introvert. (Kaelynn's Theme)
[*] Extrovert. (Chryssi's Theme)
[*] Benevolence. (Phoebe's Theme)

[i]Chryssi's grand chance to show off~[/i]

[b]General Revisions:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixes to typos, grammatical errors, and punctuation ([i]Phoebe was embarrassed by how many she found >_<[/i])

Appreciation and love to all those who've shown interest thus far and to all those who'll do so in the future!! I hope you enjoy~ <3
